limits: Source discovery is broad, not an exhaustive census of every online guide.
Catalog inclusion does not mean a complete guide audit or independent evidence.
Record status is a summary; evidence.supports identifies which fields each source actually supports.
A source agreement is not an in-game test. Unknown and disputed rules cannot justify a completion guarantee.
The 19 baseline availability records cover manual Social Links. The prototype roster separately includes three story-related links.
Document floors are recorded; Tartarus opening dates and all gatekeeper details are not yet modelled.
Only dated or preparation-sensitive requests are extracted; this is not a complete 101-request solution database.

releaseGaps.required: Complete school closures, pre-exam exceptions, holidays, sports training and per-slot story blocks.
releaseGaps.acceptance: April–January event calendar reconciled against two distinct routes; free slots never inferred from an omitted entry.

releaseGaps.required: Resolve introductions, required ranks, items, exam conditions and rank-specific availability.
releaseGaps.acceptance: Every suggested Social Link opening has a complete, cited eligibility rule and explicit unknown handling.

releaseGaps.required: Actual available meeting days inside Linked Episode windows, optional branches and missed-chain behavior.
releaseGaps.acceptance: No outer-window endpoint is presented as a guaranteed available meeting; invitation and event dates are distinct.

releaseGaps.required: Unlock dates, forced/tutorial visits, rescue access and alternatives for players needing multiple visits.
releaseGaps.acceptance: Recommendations distinguish dungeon access, document floors, rescue deadlines and author-chosen visit dates.

releaseGaps.required: Point requirements, matching Arcana effects, platonic/romance differences and recovery activities.
releaseGaps.acceptance: A rank-up suggestion can explain its assumptions and has a fallback if affinity is insufficient.

releaseGaps.required: Resolve or safely omit remaining disputed advice.
releaseGaps.acceptance: No unresolved claim drives a definitive warning or eligibility result.

releaseGaps.required: Check the semi-guide against full campaign routes and representative in-game saves.
releaseGaps.acceptance: Early, midgame and January scenarios tested, including missed rescues, missed episodes and optional events. No blanket 100% promise.
